name: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Write a Braket program building an 4-qubit GH
task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Write a Braket program building an 4-qubit GHZ circuit, print the circuit diagram, and verify with the state_vector result type that only |0...0> and |1...1> have amplitude. Return the entire program in one piece, ready to run without any modification.
